origin.description: Observed-class share minus the largest other share.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One row of vote shares per case.

arguments.name: observed
arguments.text: The true class of each row.

origin.details: Columns follow the order the labels first appear.
origin.example: votes <- matrix(c(0.7,0.3, 0.2,0.8, 0.4,0.6), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE); colnames(votes) <- c("a","b"); cat(as.numeric(margin(votes, factor(c("a","b","a")))), "\n")
